evidence.title: Captcha Interception
evidence.text: 죄송합니다. 회원님의 네트워크에서 비정상적인 트래픽이 감지되었습니다. 밀어서 확인하기

action: stop further Alibaba browser requests; preserve 72 candidates already observed

resolution.method: OpenCLI clis/alibaba/detail.js: direct browser load -> one-shot CDP punish-slider trajectory -> r.jina.ai text mirror; ladder registered as "alibaba detail"
